description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release and brings long-term support, performance improvements, and new language features. Upgrading ensures the project remains on a supported, modern runtime.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the JDK/Java version to 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to set the Java source and target compatibility to 25. Ensure all dependencies are compatible with Java 25. Fix any compilation errors or deprecation warnings introduced by the upgrade.
tasks.summary: Successfully upgraded the project from Java 21 to Java 25 LTS. Updated pom.xml java.version to 25 and Dockerfile base images to eclipse-temurin:25. Build and all unit tests pass.
